question: What is the primary objective of the Atmanirbhar Clean Plant Programme, which was launched in the 2023-24 Union Budget of the Government of India?

options.text: Enhancing the availability of disease-free planting material

solution:
The correct answer is __**Enhancing the availability of disease-free planting material**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Atmanirbhar Clean Plant Programme was launched in the Union Budget 2023-24 by the Government of India to enhance agricultural productivity and quality.
 
• The primary focus of the program is to ensure the availability of disease-free and high-quality planting materials for horticultural crops such as fruits and vegetables.
 
• This initiative aims to address challenges faced by the horticulture sector, including crop losses due to poor-quality planting materials and diseases.
 
• The program is expected to boost the horticulture industry's export potential by providing superior planting materials free from diseases.
 
• It aligns with India’s vision of self-reliance (Atmanirbhar Bharat) in agriculture and horticulture, ensuring better crop yields and farmer income.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **For Horticulture & Quality Inputs:**

 
 
• Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY): Promotes organic farming, focusing on soil health and producing safe food.
 
• National Beekeeping and Honey Mission (NBHM): Aims to develop scientific beekeeping, boosting honey production and exports, under the Atmanirbhar Bharat initiative. 
 
 
 
• **For Energy & Sustainability in Agriculture:**
 
 
• PM-KUSUM (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan): Supports solar pumps and solar power generation for farmers, reducing diesel use.
 
• National Green Hydrogen Mission: Aims to make India a leader in green hydrogen, impacting fertilizer and transport sectors.
